import pytest
from rich.console import Console
from rich.prompt import Confirm

def test_confirm_with_markup_disabled() -> None:
    console = Console(markup=False)
    with pytest.raises(Confirm.InvalidResponse) as excinfo:
        Confirm.ask("Continue", console=console, choices=["y", "n"])
    assert "[prompt.invalid]Please enter Y or N" in str(excinfo.value)
